tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans H=0.16–0.48, far shorter than the target H=23.9. A slow-horizon measurement can distinguish sustained positive gain from endogenous reversal and constrain the slow adaptation term.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon adaptation law from the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow response at the target horizon.
The pilot has zero s_grad and does not identify its sink dependence; the recalled mechanism also calls for the slow-horizon probe.
Finer short trajectories would be less directly informative about long-horizon reversal.
It is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity.
